name: elevenlabs-dubbing-studio
description: Re-voice your dubbing per character, design a full soundscape and score music to your edit with ElevenLabs. Claude writes every prompt.
long_description: Upload a finished video, its script and the dubbing. Claude watches the key frames, reads the script and the diarized dubbing, writes a voice prompt per character and gives you voice options to approve. It then re-voices every line with the approved voice, designs the ambience / foley / SFX soundscape and composes music cues timed to the edit. Everything is generated with ElevenLabs and saved as synced stems in a project folder on your computer.
